messages:
Noah Park: Quick thread on stackline UX — should the active stack frame in request drilldown get a subtle bg highlight or a bold left border? Mock: https://figma.com/file/abc (two variants) Sofia Garcia: Leaning left border. It reads like a marker and doesn't change row height. Evan Brooks: Border might conflict with severity badges on the left. Maybe inset left border (4px) + reduced opacity. Priya Singh: Accessibility: any color indicator must have a non-color affordance (icon or text) for colorblind users and use focus styling for keyboard users. a11y-bot: Contrast note: bright-yellow border on light theme fails contrast when used alone. Recommend 3:1 with underlying surface or supplemental icon. Noah Park: Good call. Proposal: left border + small "active" chevron icon that becomes aria-hidden when decorative. Sofia Garcia: UX question: copy affordance. Should we allow copying a single frame (line) vs copying the whole stack as text/JSON? Which is higher value? Evan Brooks: Both. Single frame copy is useful for Slack bug reports. Whole stack JSON is needed for exports/attachments. Priya Singh: For single-frame copy, make it reachable via keyboard: focus on line, press C to copy (with modifier?) or show an inline copy button. If we add a global shortcut, document it in keyboard help. Noah Park: I dislike global letter shortcuts since they clash. Maybe Enter/Space on a focused frame opens a mini menu with copy options. Sofia Garcia: Mini menu items: "Copy frame text", "Copy frame link", "Copy full stack (text)", "Download stack (JSON)". Keep verbs first. Evan Brooks: For copy feedback show inline toast near the line: small check + "Copied" that dismisses after 1.2s so user sees context. Don't use global toasts for this. Priya Singh: For screen readers, after copy we should update an aria-live region with a message like "Stack frame copied" and include frame number. Example: ```html
// on copy -> document.getElementById('stack-copy-live').innerText = 'Frame 3 copied to clipboard.' ``` Noah Park: Nice. Also UX microcopy: prefer concise labels: "Copy frame", "Copy link", "Export JSON". Sofia Garcia: Small accessibility nit: keyboard focus outline on the active frame should be visible in all themes. Use high-contrast focus token. a11y-bot: High-contrast mode check: 2px outline recommended for focus in high-contrast settings. Evan Brooks: Implementation detail: when exporting JSON include trace_id, frame_index, source_file, line_number, function_name, and local vars if available. Keep schema stable. Priya Singh: Thinking about export UX: modal with filename prefilled like "trace--2026-03-23.json" and a small notice: "Includes only frames visible in current view" with a checkbox: "Include full stack". Noah Park: Good. Also, do we want a compact copy format for Slack that strips long paths (use ellipses) vs full copy? Maybe menu toggles: "Copy (compact)" vs "Copy (full)". Sofia Garcia: I support compact by default for quick sharing. Add a tooltip: "Compact copies shorten file paths for chat." Evan Brooks: Analytics: track copy actions per type (frame, link, full export) to understand usage. Low-cost event. Priya Singh: Accessibility follow-up: I'll draft aria labels for menu items and the live-announcer copy messages and post here. Noah Park: Great. I'll update the Figma with left-border active state + chevron + mini menu and make two microcopy variants. Will ping when updated. :thumbsup:
